import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

test("golden_control_flow", async ({ page }) => {
  // Derived from sequential step/outcome budgets (+10% headroom, at least 1m); 4h ceiling.
  test.setTimeout(772750);

  // Results of waits with `assign:` (${waits.<name>.matched}).
  let cairnWait_banner: { matched: boolean; index?: number } = { matched: false };
  let cairnWait_saved: { matched: boolean; index?: number } = { matched: false };

  // --- steps ---
  // step: go
  await page.goto("https://example.com/rows");
  // step: maybe_banner
  cairnWait_banner = await expect.poll(async () => (await page.locator("body").innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase().includes("maintenance"), { timeout: 2000 }).toBe(true).then(() => ({ matched: true }), () => ({ matched: false }));
  // step: dismiss
  // if: var:waits.banner.matched equals:true
  if (String(cairnWait_banner.matched) === "true") {
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Dismiss" }).first().click();
  } else {
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  }
  // step: load_more
  // repeat: max 5, until text:All rows loaded
  {
    let cairnRepeat1Done = false;
    for (let cairnRepeat1 = 0; cairnRepeat1 < 5; cairnRepeat1++) {
      if (await page.evaluate((needle) => String(document.body?.innerText ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase().includes(needle), "all rows loaded")) {
        cairnRepeat1Done = true;
        break;
      }
      await page.locator(`#more-${cairnRepeat1}`).click();
      // if: var:repeat.page in:0,2
      if (["0", "2"].includes(String(cairnRepeat1))) {
        await page.getByLabel("Note").first().fill(`page ${(cairnRepeat1 + 1)}`);
      }
    }
    if (!cairnRepeat1Done) {
      cairnRepeat1Done = await page.evaluate((needle) => String(document.body?.innerText ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase().includes(needle), "all rows loaded");
    }
    expect(cairnRepeat1Done, "repeat load_more: until text:All rows loaded did not hold after 5 iteration(s)").toBe(true);
  }
  // step: fixed
  // repeat: max 3
  for (let cairnRepeat2 = 0; cairnRepeat2 < 3; cairnRepeat2++) {
    await page.keyboard.press("ArrowDown");
  }
  // step: soft
  // repeat: max 2, until url includes "/done" (onMax: continue)
  for (let cairnRepeat3 = 0; cairnRepeat3 < 2; cairnRepeat3++) {
    if (page.url().includes("/done")) {
      break;
    }
    await page.keyboard.press("Enter");
  }
  // step: outcome
  cairnWait_saved = await Promise.any([expect.poll(async () => (await page.locator("body").innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase().includes("saved"), { timeout: 5000 }).toBe(true).then(() => 0), page.waitForSelector(".error", { timeout: 5000, state: "visible" }).then(() => 1)]).then((index) => ({ matched: true, index }));
  // when: var:waits.saved.index equals:1
  if (String(cairnWait_saved.index) === "1") {
    // step: on_error
    await page.locator(".retry").click();
  }
  // step: both
  await expect.poll(async () => [(page.url().includes("/done")), ((await page.locator("body").innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase().includes("loading") === false)].every(Boolean), { timeout: 4000 }).toBe(true);
  // step: unread_optional
  await page.waitForSelector(".toast", { timeout: 1000, state: "visible" }).catch(() => undefined);
  // when: var:mode equals:fast
  if (String("fast") === "fast") {
    // step: mode_gate
    await page.locator("#fast").click();
  }
  // step: submit
  // use submit_form: retry up to 2 more time(s), until text:Thanks
  for (let cairnAttempt4 = 1; ; cairnAttempt4++) {
    try {
      // step: press_submit
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Submit" }).first().click();
      expect(await page.evaluate((needle) => String(document.body?.innerText ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase().includes(needle), "thanks"), "use submit_form: until text:Thanks did not hold").toBe(true);
      break;
    } catch (error) {
      if (cairnAttempt4 >= 3) {
        throw error;
      }
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250));
    }
  }

  // --- outcomes (the contract) ---
  // done: the list reports completion
  await expect(page.locator("body")).toContainText("Done", { ignoreCase: true, useInnerText: true });

});
